name: Creating An Enlightened
body:
Creating Enlightened Characters

Ability Score Array: 17,16,15,12,10,8.

Enlightened bonus feats: At 1st level and every 5th thereafter, choose any feat from the for which you meet prerequisites for.

Gestalt two base classes. Besides some exceptions, these are the only two classes that can be taken at the same time.

Choose one Special Attack, either from the list or one of your devising with GM’s discretion.

Choose two Special Qualities, as above.
